facts.claim: A systematic review concluded that individuals with poor social health (social isolation, lack of social support or loneliness) are 30% more likely to develop coronary heart disease (CHD) and stroke.
facts.quote: An international systematic review concluded that individuals with poor social health (social isolation, lack of social support or loneliness) are 30% more likely to develop coronary heart disease (CHD) and stroke.

research.angle: While remote work can increase autonomy and enjoyment, it is linked to social isolation, stress, and burnout, which can decrease perceived productivity and satisfaction.
research.verdict: The evidence shows that remote work provides benefits like autonomy but is simultaneously linked to negative mental health outcomes and social isolation.
research.caveat: The study on social isolation and remote work satisfaction was based on an online survey of 265 employees and shows association rather than causation.
